character.name: Idle
character.prompt: A single monster for a turn-based JRPG battle, full body, centered. Cute and warm Ghibli-like creature design, readable chunky silhouette, thick dark outline. No background, no ground, no shadow, no text, no extra characters, no weapons other than those described. A small round clockwork toy soldier robot hovering above the ground. Old brass round body, one big round eye in the middle of the face glowing warm yellow, a wind-up key sticking out of its back, short jointed mechanical arms holding a small round brass shield, a little soldier helmet crest on top. An old toy soldier come alive, endearing. Palette: #B37A55, #92552D, #8A7460, outline #2F1B10. 2D pixel art, classic 32-bit era style (16/32-bit JRPG, SNES and PlayStation 1 look), crisp square pixels, limited palette, flat shading with hard edges, no anti-aliasing, no smooth gradients, no 3D rendering.
